Commands:
  /! <command>
  /conf
  /copy {last-message|session-chat|session-id|session-name|<target>}
  /ctx
  /edit <target>
  /info
  /open <target>
  /new [<model>]
  /expose <port>
  /grant {r|rx|rw|rxw} <path>
  /grants [all]
  /revoke <target>...
  /jobs
  /job {status|output|stop|discard} <name> | prune
  /fork [<model>]

Targets:
  agents-file         config-dir          config-file
  home-dir            scratch-dir         session-chat-file
  session-dir         session-log-file    skills-dir
  snippets-dir        system-prompt-file  workspace-dir
